parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of sessions to be returned. If this parameter is not specified, 20 sessions are returned by default.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next page.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The SessionId value to filter. If specified, all session information associated with this session ID in Active or Expired states is returned.

parameters.name: sessionStatus
parameters.description: The session status to filter. By default, information for all sessions in the Active and Expired states is returned. You can specify Active to retrieve only active sessions, or Expired to retrieve only expired sessions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc list-sessions --function-name my-func --qualifier aliasName1 --limit 10 --next-token MTIzNCNhYmM= --session-status Active --session-id test-session-id-1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fc GET /2023-03-30/functions/my-func/sessions --region cn-hangzhou --nextToken 'MTIzNCNhYmM=' --qualifier aliasName1 --limit 10 --sessionStatus Active --sessionId 'test-session-id-1' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
